system.description: • Effect: On one hit of your choice against your marked prey each round, choose one: Hamstring (its speed is halved until the end of its next turn), Pin (until the end of its next turn, it can't move away from you without a Reflex save against your Class Save DC) or Expose (the next ally to attack it has Advantage). From 8th level, your Quarry Strike's hit can carry a trick too.
